review_notes: I read the whole file and checked it for competing versions of existing concepts. The candidates I considered were: the `toFun'` coercion (not replaceable by `DFunLike`, because the domain depends on the map); `LinearPMap.ker`, `eqLocus`, `codRestrict`, `comp` and `coprod` (each has a `LinearPMap`-specific domain, not a duplicate of the `LinearMap` versions); `LinearMap.toPMap`, `LinearMap.compPMap` and `domRestrict` (named specialisations); and `graph`, `inverse` and `Submodule.toLinearPMap` (no equivalent in Mathlib). I grepped Mathlib for other partial-linear-map structures. The other users of `LinearPMap` (`Algebra/Module/Injective.lean`, `HahnEmbedding.lean`, Hahn-Banach, `InnerProductSpace/LinearPMap.lean`) build on this file and do not define a rival concept. I found no independent declaration that is a competing version of one already in Mathlib, so I abstain. I did not read the other `LinearPMap` files in full.
